newsitem.title: USA: Wasatch stake sold to Aviation Holdings.
newsitem.headline: Wasatch stake sold to Aviation Holdings.

text.p: Wasatch International Corp said Monday that Aviation Holdings Group has purchased 10 million shares of its Class A common stock from LaSalle Holdings Ltd.
The purchase price was not disclosed.
LaSalle, a Cayman Island company, is controlled by Anne Greyling. The stock purchase eliminates Greyling's control of Wasatch.
Aviation is now the largest shareholder of Wasatch, controlling about 33 percent of the 30 million outstanding shares.

"By consolidating control of Wasatch, we will now be able to pursue investments in the U.S. aviation industry," Aviation President Joe Logan, who also is president of Wasatch International, said in a news release.
"We'll also be able to be in a more secure position to develop our property in the Bahamas, and consider other development opportunities in the transportation and hospitality industries," Logan said.
